sources.source_name: Wikimedia Commons Sudan orders and medals category tree
sources.content_coverage: Category tree, file pages and original open files
sources.image_quality_notes: Original files and license data available per file page.
sources.coverage_result: 21 categories and 148 file pages processed; all 87 reviewed complete-object retry candidates recovered; 0 final retry failures
sources.notes: Original-file requests were rate-limited; complete objects were recovered through cached Commons thumbnail endpoints with controlled eight-second intervals. Ribbon-only and person branches were excluded.
